main_text.l: Defectio à Christo Dei filio per fratercules Mendicantes.

NOTA hoc loco, talem à Christo defectionem per hos Satanæ ministros hypocritas, qualis non fuit à prima plantatæ per Apostolos ecclesiæ ori-gine, Ioachimus abbas in commentario super Hieremiam, tempus æstimat esse periculosum futurum, ab anno Domini 1200, usque ad ultimos dies. In quibus apparebit (inquit) lex libertatis. Euangelium regni Christi tunc prædicabitur, & ecclesia purgabitur, ut à palea & zizaniis triticum, etc. Dum in profunda cæcitatis & ignorantiæ caligine dormirent ecclesiæ proceres, his diebus, malis uidete quid fecerit Sathan. Quosdam impostores malignos statim suscitauit, qui in humilitate & religione angelorum ambulantes, inflati tamen sensu suæ carnis, ut Paulus habet Coloss. 2. uerum Christi Euangelium auferre ab ecclesia, delere ac destruere nitebantur. Et hi Dominicani ac Franciscani uocabantur, qui circiter annum prædictum nati primum erant, Dominicani scilicet anno Domini 1204. Franciscani 1207, ut Martinus Carsulanus eorum chronographus supputat. Verumtamen uterque Matthæus noster Parisius & Vuestmonasterius, Dominicanos anno Domini 1197. origine habuisse scribit. Hi nempe uidebant se aliter

page.notes: Printed text is largely legible. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The ff ligature in "habuiffe" was read as the long-s form "habuisse". Ligature "st" and similar were transcribed as plain letters. Underlined words (Ioachimus abbas, Quosdam impostores malignos, Dominicani, Franciscani) were not marked as italic. "Vuestmonasterius" is the printed form and is kept as printed. The running head "APPENDICES." is printed at the top of the page. The catchword "ter" is the continuation of "aliter" on the next page.
